previous.explanation_en: 大家 is the conventional word for everyone or everybody in a group. 家 can suggest a household or group of people, but the whole meaning is established and cannot be worked out precisely as “big household.”
previous.caveat_en: The everyday meaning “everyone” is conventional; the parts do not define exactly which people are included.

parts.contribution_en: part of the established word; it does not simply mean “big” in this expression
can suggest a household or group, but does not independently mean “everyone”

requests.reason: Research what 家 and 大 contribute to the everyone sense. Explain supported lexical development if available; do not substitute an invented big-family story or an unsupported claim of opacity.
